transcript.en: You write your message on a blank sheet of printer paper torn in half. Of all of your attempted correspondences, this one is the most to the point. Name and intention. Why bother with anything else?
transcript.zh: 你在一张撕成两半的空白打印纸上写下你的留言。在你们尝试过的所有联系当中，这一次最为直截了当。写明姓名和来意。又何必再多费唇舌？

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: Hi, you write. We're your sons. We've tried reaching out to you. We'd like to meet you.
transcript.zh: “你好，”你写道，“我们是你的儿子。我们曾试图联系你。我们想见见你。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: We've booked your 5 o'clock appointment. We'll be waiting across the street in front of the café and would love to speak. Connor and Sayre.
transcript.zh: 我们预约了你下午5点的时段。我们会在街对面的咖啡馆门口等你，很希望能和你聊聊。Connor 和 Sayre。”

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: I'm going to write his name on the front.
transcript.zh: 我要在正面写上他的名字。

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: Yeah. I mean, the thing is, too, is what if he's right there?
transcript.zh: 行。不过问题是，万一他当时就在那儿呢？

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: I mean, we're going to hand it to him.
transcript.zh: 我的意思是，我们本来就是要亲手递给他的。

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: Yeah.
transcript.zh: 对。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: So he is going to be right there.
transcript.zh: 所以他肯定就在那儿啊。

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: How are you going to do that?
transcript.zh: 那你打算怎么递给他？

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: You have booked your birth father's last appointment of the day at his barber shop. When he calls you up for your haircut, you'll hand him the note, telling him to meet you across the street.
transcript.zh: 你们已经预约了亲生父亲理发店当天最后一个时段。等他叫你们过去理发时，你们就把纸条递给他，让他到街对面碰面。

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: How are you going to do that?
transcript.zh: 那你打算怎么递给他？

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: Walk up to him and go, like, hi, I'm your 5 o'clock. One of us will have to do it. I'm your 5 o'clock, hand it to him, and then we'll walk out.
transcript.zh: 走过去跟他说，嗨，我是约了5点的客人——总得有个人去说嘛。说一句“我是约了5点的”，把纸条递给他，然后我们就走出来。

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: Do you want to do that?
transcript.zh: 你想去干这事吗？

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: I can do it. Do you want to do it?
transcript.zh: 我可以去啊。你想去吗？

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: No.
transcript.zh: 不想。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: Okay.
transcript.zh: 好吧。

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: Not at all.
transcript.zh: 一点都不想。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: It's spring of 2022 in Los Angeles. You are 29 years old. It's been nearly a year since you first sent your email to your birth father, asking to meet.
transcript.zh: 此时是2022年春天的洛杉矶。你29岁了。距离你第一次给亲生父亲发邮件请求见面，已经过去了将近一年。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: Nearly two years to the day since Connor first called you and asked to look for your birth father. Now your brother is here, in front of you, hunched in front of the mirror, pulling his hair into two loose braids.
transcript.zh: 距离 Connor 第一次给你打电话、提议一起寻找亲生父亲，也几乎整整过去两年了。此刻，你的兄弟就在你面前，弓着身子站在镜子前，把头发松松地编成两条辫子。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: It's 4:23 PM.
transcript.zh: 现在是下午4点23分。

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: We should probably get going.
transcript.zh: 我们差不多该出发了。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: Yeah, we should get going because we're going to need time to park and stuff too.
transcript.zh: 对，我们得走了，毕竟还得留出找车位之类的时间。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: You ready, Connor?
transcript.zh: 准备好了吗，Connor？

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: Yeah.
transcript.zh: 好了。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: Just make sure I have everything.
transcript.zh: 确认一下东西都带齐了。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: You're both quiet as you walk out the door.
transcript.zh: 走出家门时，你们俩都默不作声。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: You can get in.
transcript.zh: 你可以上车了。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: Okay.
transcript.zh: 行。

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: Okay. How are you feeling?
transcript.zh: 好。你现在感觉怎么样？

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: I'm scared. I'm nervous.
transcript.zh: 我好害怕。我很紧张。

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: Yeah. What are you nervous about?
transcript.zh: 嗯。你在紧张什么？

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: That he's going to be mean.
transcript.zh: 怕他会对我们态度很差。

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: Yeah. Well, he doesn't really have the right to be mean.
transcript.zh: 嗯。不过，他其实根本没资格对我们摆臭脸。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: Yeah, but that doesn't stop anyone from being mean.
transcript.zh: 话是这么说，可这并不能阻止别人对你态度恶劣啊。

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: No, I know. But, I don't know. I mean, I feel defensive of you.
transcript.zh: 是啊，我懂。不过，怎么说呢，我会本能地想护着你。

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: So if he was mean to us, I think about it as he's mean to you, where I care more, I guess.
transcript.zh: 所以如果他对我们不客气，我会觉得他是在欺负你，而我大概会更在意这个。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: That's mostly what I'm—I'm afraid of him being mean to you, too. I don't really care what he says to me. I don't want him to hurt you.
transcript.zh: 其实我最担心的，也是怕他对你不客气。他对我说什么我都无所谓，我只是不想让他伤害你。

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: Same here.
transcript.zh: 我也是。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: You pull down the driveway and onto the mile that separates you from your birth father. This street is ordinary to you now.
transcript.zh: 你们把车开出车道，驶上这隔开你和生父的那一英里路。对你来说，这条街如今再寻常不过。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: In the nearly two years you have lived here, you have driven it hundreds of times, walked it, drunk, sweaty, in the rain. You've kissed strangers on this street at midnight, mouth full of ash.
transcript.zh: 住在这里将近两年，你开车走过几百遍，也步行走过——醉醺醺地、汗津津地，或者在雨里。你曾在午夜的这条街上吻过陌生人，满嘴都是烟灰味。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: Time widens the aperture. Certain features pass flat against the windshield as you drive. Others stay inexplicably in the fore—
transcript.zh: 时间仿佛调大了光圈。开车经过时，有些街景在挡风玻璃前平平掠过，有些却莫名地凸显在眼前：

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: the laundromat that you went to the day you arrived here, the bar with the barnhouse facade, which you will never step inside of the entire time you live in Los Angeles,
transcript.zh: 你刚来这里那天去过的自助洗衣店，那家有着谷仓门面的酒吧——在洛杉矶住的整段时间里你都从未踏足过，

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: the white house with busts lined across the roof and a headless angel in the yard, the psychic's front porch.
transcript.zh: 屋顶上排满半身雕像、院子里立着无头天使的白色房子，还有那位通灵师家的前廊。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: What time is it?
transcript.zh: 几点了？

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.zh: 四点三十四。四点三十四分。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: Okay.
transcript.zh: 好。

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: Okay, well, we're outside of it. Hmm. This somehow got so much harder now that we're here.
transcript.zh: 行，我们到店门口了。嗯……怎么真到了这儿，反倒觉得难了这么多。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: You are now 20 minutes early, which gives Connor time to reconsider the plan entirely.
transcript.zh: 你们早到了二十分钟，这也给了 Connor 足够的时间把整个计划全盘推翻。

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: Do you think we should try—I know you plan on doing the note, but do you think that we should call him?
transcript.zh: 你觉得我们要不要试着……我知道你打算递纸条，但你觉得我们该不该给他打个电话？

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: Yeah, but we already tried calling.
transcript.zh: 可我们之前打过电话了啊。

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: But we call his barbershop and be like, "Hey, I got an appointment for him at 5 o'clock." He'll say, "Yeah, sure, let me check."
transcript.zh: 但我们可以打去他的理发店说：“喂，我约了他五点剪头发。”他就会说：“行，没问题，我查一下。”

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: And then what? Say exactly what's in the note? Say we're outside?
transcript.zh: 然后呢？直接照着纸条上的念？说我们就在外面？

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: Hey, yeah, this is your sons.
transcript.zh: “嗨，对，我们是你儿子。”

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: What if he hangs up?
transcript.zh: 万一他直接挂了呢？

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: Then we go in there.
transcript.zh: 那我们就直接进去。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: And do what?
transcript.zh: 进去干嘛？

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: We say, "Fuck you." I don't know. I'm okay with doing that. I've always wanted to say "fuck you" to Dad.
transcript.zh: 就冲他说一句：“去你的。”我也不知道，反正我无所谓。我一直都想对老爸骂一句“去你的”。

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: Do you want to go in together? Would that make you feel better about it?
transcript.zh: 你想一起进去吗？那样会不会让你好受点？

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: I mean, if you want to, I'm down.
transcript.zh: 嗯，如果你想的话，我没问题。

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: I want him to look at us in the case that he decides that he doesn't want to deal with it, so that he can at least do it once.
transcript.zh: 我是想，万一他决定不愿面对，至少他也得亲眼看我们一眼，哪怕就这么一次。

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: If he decides to avoid conversation with us, at least going in there and him seeing our face, I can be like, "Hey, I'm here, and I see you."
transcript.zh: 就算他打定主意躲着不跟我们说话，至少我们走进去让他看到我们的脸，我也能当面告诉他：“嘿，我来了，我看见你了。”

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: Okay, two minutes.
transcript.zh: 好了，还有两分钟。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: One minute till five.
transcript.zh: 差一分钟五点。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: Okay. Are you ready?
transcript.zh: 行了，准备好了吗？

transcript.speaker: Connor
transcript.en: Yeah, you?
transcript.zh: 嗯，你呢？

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: As ready as I can be.
transcript.zh: 能准备的都准备好了。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: The first words your birth father ever says to you:
transcript.zh: 你生父对你说的第一句话是：

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.en: Do you have an appointment?
transcript.zh: 有预约吗？

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: Yeah, five.
transcript.zh: 有，五点的。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: You sit down and wait your turn. You can barely get yourself to look up at him.
transcript.zh: 你坐下来等轮到自己，几乎鼓不起勇气抬头看他。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: You fix your eyes first on the wine-colored tiles, then the client's sneakers, slack against the footrest, the shapeless, oversized black barber's tarp.
transcript.zh: 你的视线先是定在酒红色的地砖上，接着落到客人松垮搭在脚踏板上的运动鞋，还有那块肥大、毫无版型的黑色理发围布。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: Then, your father's hands as he trims stray hairs, chatting easily over the jazz music playing softly over the speakers.
transcript.zh: 然后，你看到父亲修剪杂毛的手——音响里轻柔地放着爵士乐，他正伴着音乐轻松闲聊。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: The walls are lined with framed photographs of what you assume were once famous Hollywood actors, whose faces you do not recognize and names you do not know.
transcript.zh: 墙上挂满了一排排装裱好的照片，你猜大概都是曾经当红的好莱坞演员，可他们的脸你认不出，名字也一个不知道。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: In the corner, the magazine rack full of vintage Playboy magazines.
transcript.zh: 角落里的杂志架上，塞满了古早的《花花公子》杂志。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: Your birth father brushes clean his client's forehead and nape with a blonde duster brush, says goodbye cheerily.
transcript.zh: 你的生父用一把浅金色的扫发刷把客人的额头和后颈扫干净，又愉快地道了别。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: He glances over at you and Connor, and then calmly walks to the back door of the shop.
transcript.zh: 他朝你和 Connor 瞥了一眼，随后淡定地走向店里的后门。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: He disappears for five seconds, then 10, then 15.
transcript.zh: 他消失了五秒，十秒，十五秒。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: He returns with a broom, and slowly, methodically, sweeps the hair into a dust—
transcript.zh: 他拿着一把扫帚走回来，不紧不慢、一丝不苟地把地上的碎发扫进簸——

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: bin, and then the trash.
transcript.zh: 箕里，再倒进垃圾桶。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: You imagine everything leading up to this moment from his point of view.
transcript.zh: 你试着站在他的视角，回想这一刻之前发生的一切。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: Today he woke up, probably had a coffee, kissed his wife goodbye, drove to work, attended to some regulars,
transcript.zh: 今天他一早醒来，大概喝了杯咖啡，吻别妻子，开车去店里，照常接待了几个老主顾，

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: made small talk about the relief of 70-degree weather or the impending invasion of Ukraine as he lined up their beards and hairlines, took a quick lunch break, scrolled on Facebook on his phone.
transcript.zh: 一边修剪胡须和发际线，一边随口聊聊这终于回暖到70华氏度的好天气，或者乌克兰一触即发的战事；抽空匆匆吃了顿午饭，拿手机刷了刷 Facebook。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: Ten minutes ago, he probably looked up at the clock, saw two young guys walk in, and felt a wave of relief, the last customers.
transcript.zh: 十分钟前，他大概抬头看了眼挂钟，见两个年轻小伙子推门进来，心里还暗暗松了口气——这是今天最后两位客人了。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: As he finished sweeping the hair into a bin, he was probably hit with the feeling of relaxation that comes with knowing that the day is nearly done.
transcript.zh: 等他把碎发扫进簸箕，想到一天忙完、马上就能收工，浑身上下大概正泛起一阵轻松感。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: Now, he calls those boys up to the chair. One of them, the curly-haired one, who can barely look him in the eye, pulls a note from his pocket and hands it to him.
transcript.zh: 现在，他招呼那两个男孩坐到理发椅前。其中一个卷头发的小伙子几乎不敢正眼看他，从口袋里掏出一张纸条递了过来。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: His name is written on the front. And both boys walk out, wordlessly.
transcript.zh: 纸条正面写着他的名字。随后，两个男孩一言不发地转身走出了店门。

transcript.speaker: Sayre Quevedo
transcript.en: And now, what has been up until this moment a very ordinary day has become a monumental one in just a few seconds.
transcript.zh: 就这样，此前平平无奇的一天，在短短几秒钟内变得非同寻常。

transcript.speaker: Ira Glass
transcript.en: So what you just heard was made of excerpts from the first three episodes of Reaching Out. The podcast comes from Futuro and KCRW.
transcript.zh: 大家刚才听到的内容，节选自播客 Reaching Out 的前三集。这档节目由 Futuro 与 KCRW 联合出品。

transcript.speaker: Ira Glass
transcript.en: We are right now leaving off the story in the middle of episode 3, and I really encourage you to go hear what is about to happen. Some big, big turns are right ahead. It's very satisfying.
transcript.zh: 我们现在刚好在第三集讲到一半的地方暂告一段落，我强烈建议大家去听听接下来会发生什么。后面紧接着就有几个非常重磅的转折，听起来相当过瘾。

transcript.speaker: Ira Glass
transcript.en: Then, episode 4 comes out later this week, and you can actually listen to all six episodes right now if you subscribe to Futuro Plus.
transcript.zh: 第四集将在本周晚些时候上线；不过如果你订阅了 Futuro Plus，现在就能一口气听完全部六集。

transcript.speaker: Ira Glass
transcript.en: And if you dive in that way, maybe go back to episodes 1 and 2. They contain stuff you have not heard in our excerpts today.
transcript.zh: 如果打算追下去的话，不妨也回头听听第一集和第二集，里面还有不少我们今天节选里没放出来的精彩内容。

transcript.zh: 今天参与我们这期节目制作的人员包括：本期制作人 Nadia Reiman，以及 Adrienne Lilly、Tobin Low、Andrea Marks、Stowe Nelson、Ruthie Petitto、Anthony Roman、Ruby Schwartz、Lilly Sullivan、Frances Swanson、Christopher Swetala、Julie Whitaker 和 Diane Wu。

transcript.zh: 我们的执行编辑是 Sarah Abdurrahman，资深编辑是 David Kestenbaum 和 Nancy Updike，执行主编是 Emanuele Berry。

transcript.zh: This American Life 由公共广播交换网 PRX（Public Radio Exchange）向各公共广播电台分发播出。一如既往地感谢我们节目的联合创始人 Torey Malatia 先生。

transcript.speaker: Ira Glass
transcript.en: You know, whenever he returns from lunch, this is what he says to me. I don't know what to make of it.
transcript.zh: 说起来，每次他吃完午饭回来，都会对我说这么一句。我真不知道该怎么接话。

transcript.speaker: Torey Malatia
transcript.en: I'm back. Your mommy's back.
transcript.zh: 我回来啦，你妈咪回来啦。

transcript.speaker: Ira Glass
transcript.en: Thanks, I guess. I'm Ira Glass. Back next week with more stories of This American Life.
transcript.zh: 那……谢谢了？我是 Ira Glass，下周同一时间，继续为您带来 This American Life 的更多故事。
